'''Leary''' was a group of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] sent to capture [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Outpost. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] guarded the operation and destroyed three Imperial shuttles sent in after disabling the gunboats. The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Cathleen]]'' would then arrive to retrieve the gunboats and Leary.
